pairs.subject: copy-quality-gates
pairs.evidence: desk/src/design/desk-landing.css:106 Landing headlines are clipped after two lines, while inspected checks measure word count and outer bounds without detecting clipped text, so passing copy can lose visible content.

techniques.evidence: desk/src/landing/model.ts:4 The shared wording model and landing design document provide product principles and examples, but searches located no copy contract declaring language mechanics, a termbase, rule dispositions and copy-review ownership.
desk/src/landing/model.ts:80 This normalization assembles spoken UI text; no landing gate autocorrector, repair findings or repair-report workflow was located.
tools/tv-landing-live.cjs:3 The landing's browser copy checks explicitly sit outside the aggregate test command; no mandatory landing diff or end-of-session enforcement seam was located.

desk/src/tv/landingRows.ts:99 Product prose remains inline in TypeScript; inspected tests check selected wording and lengths, but no counted source-copy gate enforcing the standard's L1 catalog, typography and terminology checks was located.

desk/src/design/desk-landing.css:107 Caption details occupy a clipped two-line box, but the landing tests use a 25-word cap and safe-zone measurements without checking internal text overflow or producing an overflow finding.

tools/tv-keys-test.cjs:587 This wording check extracts only three forms of literal assignment from source lines; caption templates and JSX wording have no independently counted rendered-unit extraction coverage.

tools/tv-landing-test.cjs:68 The caption rule's blocking disposition and threshold are implicit in an assertion, with no rule identifier or separately declared disposition; no landing severity configuration was located.
docs/DESIGN-STUDY-DESK.md:123 The landing's design document declares the desk English in Phase 1, and searches located no landing target catalogs or findings across two checked languages.
